description: Use the chrome.wallpaper API to get wallpaper colors and listen for wallpaper changes.

types.description: Colors extracted from the device wallpaper.

primaryColor.description: Primary wallpaper color as ARGB integer.

secondaryColor.description: Secondary wallpaper color as ARGB integer (may be absent).

tertiaryColor.description: Tertiary wallpaper color as ARGB integer (may be absent).

colorHints.description: Color hints bitmask. Bit 0 (0x1): supports dark text. Bit 1 (0x2): supports dark theme.

parameters.name: colors
parameters.description: The wallpaper colors, or null if unavailable.

events.name: onChanged
events.description: Fired when the wallpaper colors change.
